structured.answer: I didn't pick anything. It's endless rows of numbers about shares and dollars, from companies I mostly don't know (מור, אנליסט, מיטב), I couldn't find any bank or anything as safe as a deposit, so I'll ask you or the bank before I open a kupat gemel.

findings.what: Dark background with grey small text. The column headings and the fee labels are hard to read even enlarged.
Opens with shares, s&p and index trackers. Nothing for someone who wants safe saving.
Too many numbers in each row (fee, two exposures, two returns, assets, a ring). It made me anxious.
The first company's name was missing once the table scrolled, so I didn't know whose tracks I was reading
Big return numbers like 26.39% and 25.86% jump out, but nothing says these can also go down
Unclear if returns are per year or total; the explanation is in a small grey heading
Companies I've never heard of. I wouldn't give them money.
The yellow warning that the data hasn't been updated worried me. Can I trust these numbers?
The list is very long (143 tracks). I stopped after six screens and never saw the rest.
